title: Family
ownerHint: You are the admin. Add each family member with their name and email, then send them their own link. They sign in with the email; everyone sees the name.
memberHint: Everyone who can use the app. Only the admin can add or remove people.
name: Name
tempPasswordHint: At least 6 letters or digits. They choose their own password the first time they sign in.
removeHint: They can no longer sign in. Everything they already entered stays.
adminHint: They will manage the family instead of you. You stay as a member.
added: {name} is added. Send their link now.
loadFailed: Couldn't load the family. Check your connection.

errors.bad_name: Write the name in English letters
errors.owner_only: Only the admin can do this
errors.failed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
errors.weak_password: That password is too easy to guess. Try another one.
errors.add_failed: Couldn't add them. Check your connection and try again.
errors.email_taken: This email already has a login. Use another email.
errors.suspended: This family is paused. Contact the person who runs the app.
errors.too_many: You sent a lot of invites today. Try again tomorrow.

nameHint: In English letters. This is the name everyone sees in the app.
emailHint: They sign in with this email. No email? Use yours with a tag, like you+mama@gmail.com.
inviteMemberHint: The link works for 24 hours. Whoever opens it adds their details and joins your family.
inviteFailed: Couldn't send the invite. Try again.
otherFamiliesHint: Know a family who'd love this app? Invite them. Their space is private, just like yours.
inviteFamilyHint: They open the app and create their own account with this email. They have 24 hours, then the invite is cancelled.
friendEmailHint: They create their account with this email.
familyInviteText: Hi {name}! We've been using a simple app to keep track of our family's money, and I think you'll love it too. I've invited your family, so you'll get your own private space. Open the app, choose to create your account, and use the email I invited you with. The invite lasts 24 hours. Here's the app:
inviteWithLink: Join {family} on our family accounts app. Open this link on your phone to join:
newFamilyInviteText: We use a simple app to track our family's money — I think you'll love it! I'm sharing a link so you can set up your own family space. Open it on your phone within 24 hours:
newFamilyInviteHint: The link expires in 24 hours. They open it to set up their own family.
currenciesHint: The single currency used across all your wallets, entries, and goals.
convertExplanation: Converting to {currency} will update all existing wallet balances, past entries, goals, and budgets using this exchange rate.
rateFetchFailed: Could not fetch online rate. You can enter the rate manually.
currencyInUse: A wallet still uses a currency you removed
